note: What a site of the techno-Byzantine theme is dressed with in the H9 client (Xash3D FWGS): accent glows, ambient sounds and props. Names only, of files the H9 client has (checked 2026-11-03); nothing of the game's is in the kit. Measured from H9's own maps and the TS maps in its folder: glows as env_glow in rendermode 3 (stock TS: 100-150 a map), sounds as looped ambient_generic (H9: 1.5 to 3.6 a 1000 m2), props as ts_model with a CLIP brush under the big furniture (H9: at least 358 of 1021 props clipped).

accents.note: rim and backdrop: glow mode (3), high over the street, its size kept on the screen; the rest, at a player's height: additive (5) at scale 0.4 (64-pixel sprites, about 26 units), which a glow mode drew as a square filling the screen up close (seen in H9, 2026-11-03)

kowloon.note: The Kowloon facade (kowloon.mjs): texture names only (no `{` mask in the world: it draws filled, MAPS-MAKING.md), from specialists.wad, halflife.wad and the Mese's wad. `districts` turns it on for whole districts (empty: only buildings that say `kowloon` in the spec). signs and windows carry the picture's size in texels.
